title: Perry Crane Services tackles complex tree removals with National Crane NTC45-2
summary: The crane is essential for handling challenging jobs that require precision lifting and dependable equipment, including those with constrained access and complex removal requirements.Equipped with a 127 ft boom and 45 USt capacity, the National Crane boom truck provides an ideal balance of reach and lifting performance for the trees commonly found throughout the region.
body_markdown:
- The crane is essential for handling challenging jobs that require precision lifting and dependable equipment, including those with constrained access and complex removal requirements.
- Equipped with a 127 ft boom and 45 USt capacity, the National Crane boom truck provides an ideal balance of reach and lifting performance for the trees commonly found throughout the region.


When Travis Perry gets a call requesting support for a tree removal project, he knows a challenging job awaits. The owner and operator of Perry Crane Services also knows he has the ideal machine to handle it: a National Crane NTC45-2 boom truck. Based in West Bridgewater, Massachusetts,[Perry Crane Services](https://www.perrycraneservices.com/) specializes in complex tree removal operations that require precision lifting and dependable equipment.


“Most of the work we handle involves extremely difficult removals where access is constrained, or the terrain is too steep, or other equipment simply can’t reach the tree,” explains Perry. “Many of these trees are dead, structurally compromised, or positioned over homes and buildings, making them very dangerous to remove by hand. The NTC45-2 gives us the reach, capacity and compact footprint we need to complete these jobs safely and efficiently.”


Before launching Perry Crane Services in 2023, Perry operated a previous-generation National Crane model, and he closely followed the development of the NTC45-2. With 20 years specializing in tree removal, including 15 years of experience as a crane operator, Perry was impressed by the capabilities of National Crane’s newly introduced model. When it came time to purchase a crane for his new company, the decision was easy.


“I knew I needed a crane that combined strong lifting performance with a compact package,” said Perry. “The NTC45-2 checked every box. The longer outrigger stroke, super-compact configuration, counterweight design and overall versatility make it an incredible machine for the type of work we do. I could talk for hours about its advantages. In my opinion, it’s the perfect crane for this niche. I haven’t had a day off since I put the license plates on it.”


Perry purchased an NTC45-2 equipped with a 127 ft boom, providing the reach needed to work around structures and other obstacles while maintaining strong load charts at longer radii, a crucial advantage for tree removal applications. With a 45 USt capacity, the boom truck is frequently used to remove large tree sections weighing between 3,000 lb and 5,000 lb, as well as larger base logs weighing nearly 18,000 lb. The combination of reach and lifting capacity makes the crane well suited to the large trees commonly found throughout the region.
